# Hypotheses Draft - LLM-based Unit Test Generation

Date: 2026-06-04  
Source: `experiment/01_rq.md`, `experiment/design-rationale.md`

## RQ1 - Mutation Score

**RQ1:** On the same set of unit-test-generation tasks, do unit tests generated by a structured/chain-of-thought prompt achieve higher mutation score than unit tests generated by a zero-shot prompt?

**H0:** Unit tests generated by a structured/chain-of-thought prompt do **not** achieve higher mutation score than unit tests generated by a zero-shot prompt on the same unit-test-generation tasks.

**H1:** Unit tests generated by a structured/chain-of-thought prompt achieve higher mutation score than unit tests generated by a zero-shot prompt on the same unit-test-generation tasks.

**Expected statistical test:** Wilcoxon signed-rank test  
**Alternative test if data are unpaired:** Mann-Whitney U test  
**Alpha:** α = 0.05  
**Metric:** Mutation score

## RQ2 - Branch Coverage

**RQ2:** On the same set of unit-test-generation tasks, do unit tests generated by a structured/chain-of-thought prompt achieve higher branch coverage than unit tests generated by a zero-shot prompt?

**H0:** Unit tests generated by a structured/chain-of-thought prompt do **not** achieve higher branch coverage than unit tests generated by a zero-shot prompt on the same unit-test-generation tasks.

**H1:** Unit tests generated by a structured/chain-of-thought prompt achieve higher branch coverage than unit tests generated by a zero-shot prompt on the same unit-test-generation tasks.

**Expected statistical test:** Wilcoxon signed-rank test  
**Alternative test if data are unpaired:** Mann-Whitney U test  
**Alpha:** α = 0.05  
**Metric:** Branch coverage

## Statistical Test Rationale

Mutation score and branch coverage are numeric outputs. The planned experiment evaluates the same tasks under both prompt strategies, so the observations are paired. Because the result distribution is unknown and the sample may be small, the Wilcoxon signed-rank test is the safest planned test. If some paired observations are lost and the final data become independent groups, Mann-Whitney U will be used instead.
